column4: Implement owner-attested pickup for a later independent step when the current step is blocked. Preserve serial chains and explicit waiting_for gates; align check, queue, take, settle, audit, and status.

Verify in an isolated fixture that an explicitly independent later task is dispatchable and can finish while its predecessor remains blocked, then verify normal predecessor completion advances across it. Verify default serial and explicit wait gates remain enforced.

Verify canonical task-ledger revisions and audit/status/queue output expose the blocked predecessor, independent runnable task, taking transition, and completion without duplicate task rows; record the exact commands and outcome in a receipt.
